_note: School of Sport container context pack for referencing-intermediate. The School of Sport spans several sport subjects (sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, strength & conditioning); worked examples draw on a different subject lesson to lesson. There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark. context.label is 'sport' so {{context}} tokens resolve to 'sport'.
